exceptions.name: ForbiddenTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Attempting an invalid state machine transition.
exceptions.rationale: State integrity violation; client logic error.

exceptions.name: ArtifactNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Core references a valid digest, but file is missing from disk.
exceptions.rationale: Logs warning and returns structurally safe domain error to caller instead of crashing.

exceptions.name: InvalidArtifactReferenceError
exceptions.trigger: Reference string fails regex or length validation before OS resolution.
exceptions.rationale: Pre-emptive security boundary check failed.

exceptions.name: ArtifactTamperedError
exceptions.trigger: Hash mismatch during read verification.
exceptions.rationale: Data integrity violation; must strictly block use of corrupted data.

exceptions.name: SecurityBoundaryError
exceptions.trigger: Path traversal, symlink, or reserved OS name detected.
exceptions.rationale: Strict security quarantine blocks execution.

exceptions.name: MissingDependencyError
exceptions.trigger: Extension manifest requires unavailable module.
exceptions.rationale: Extension safely placed in FAILED state and skipped during boot.

exceptions.name: RegistrationConflictError
exceptions.trigger: Two extensions claim the same ID.
exceptions.rationale: Idempotency violated by collision. Second caller is rejected.

exceptions.name: DowngradeNotSupportedError
exceptions.trigger: Schema version loaded is older than DB version.
exceptions.rationale: Prevents data corruption from legacy code schemas.

exceptions.name: MemoryError
exceptions.trigger: Loading artifact payload into memory.
exceptions.rationale: Stream chunking mechanism avoids OOM natively.

exceptions.name: IOError_ENOSPC
exceptions.trigger: Disk full during staging.
exceptions.rationale: Atomic write fails gracefully, staging file aggressively removed.

exceptions.name: PartialReadError
exceptions.trigger: Stream read interrupted.
exceptions.rationale: Aborts staging before digestion; temp file swept.

exceptions.name: SchemaValidationError
exceptions.trigger: Extension manifest is structurally malformed.
exceptions.rationale: Strict JSON schema Draft 2020-12 enforcement.

exceptions.name: TypeMismatchError
exceptions.trigger: Manifest uses null instead of strictly typed string.
exceptions.rationale: Strict typing constraint failure.

exceptions.name: ExtensionHookError
exceptions.trigger: User extension callback throws unhandled exception.
exceptions.rationale: Trapped by host boundary; extension safely moves to FAILED.

exceptions.name: FileExistsError
exceptions.trigger: Atomic rename target already exists.
exceptions.rationale: Proof of idempotent duplicate upload; resolves safely to existing file.

exceptions.name: SQLiteBusyError
exceptions.trigger: Concurrent write lock during migration.
exceptions.rationale: Driver retry timeout fences reads and eventually resolves.

exceptions.name: CorruptMetadataError
exceptions.trigger: DB artifact record is missing or garbled.
exceptions.rationale: State is recoverable via physical payload cryptographic hashing.

exceptions.name: WindowsJunctionError
exceptions.trigger: Reparse point detected in payload path.
exceptions.rationale: Windows-specific security rule enforcement.

exceptions.name: UnicodeNormalizationError
exceptions.trigger: NFC/NFD confusion in path string.
exceptions.rationale: Not applicable; system strictly uses ASCII hex digests.

exceptions.name: NULByteError
exceptions.trigger: NUL byte in path reference string.
exceptions.rationale: Pre-OS regex validation catches before triggering OS ValueError.

exceptions.name: ReservedDeviceNameError
exceptions.trigger: Path attempts to use CON, NUL, PRN.
exceptions.rationale: Windows OS constraint bypassed safely via application-level regex.

exceptions.name: PathTooLongError
exceptions.trigger: Exceeding 260 chars MAX_PATH on Windows.
exceptions.rationale: System uses Windows `\\?\` long path prefix natively.

exceptions.name: OrphanGarbageCollectionError
exceptions.trigger: Attempting to GC file currently locked by OS read.
exceptions.rationale: Windows mandatory file lock prevents GC; deferred to next cycle.

exceptions.name: MigrationCrashError
exceptions.trigger: Process forcefully dies mid-migration.
exceptions.rationale: SQLite WAL rollback ensures state consistency on subsequent boot.

exceptions.name: HostileSymlinkError
exceptions.trigger: Payload is a symlink pointing out of bounds.
exceptions.rationale: Hostile Boundary enforcement.

exceptions.name: ZeroByteOverwriteError
exceptions.trigger: Tampered file manually truncated to 0 bytes.
exceptions.rationale: Read-time size check catches before hash stream executes.

exceptions.name: DuplicateCommitIdempotencyTrigger
exceptions.trigger: Re-uploading known digest payload.
exceptions.rationale: Fast-paths to existing metadata seamlessly.

exceptions.name: ConcurrentStagingCollision
exceptions.trigger: Two processes write to identical temporary name.
exceptions.rationale: mkstemp uniqueness guarantees disjoint writes by suffix.

exceptions.name: AtomicRenameCrashError
exceptions.trigger: Power loss during commit.
exceptions.rationale: Leaves `.tmp` file which Boot GC sweeps cleanly.

exceptions.name: EmptyArtifactError
exceptions.trigger: Zero-byte payload submitted.
exceptions.rationale: Perfectly valid; hashed to known e3b0c442... digest.

exceptions.name: WorkRevisionConflictError
exceptions.trigger: Mutation expected_revision does not match current projection revision.
exceptions.rationale: CAS optimistic concurrency conflict; preserves ordering truth.

exceptions.name: WorkNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Referenced work_id does not exist in projection or stream.
exceptions.rationale: Unknown work entity reference.

exceptions.name: InvalidWorkPayloadError
exceptions.trigger: Work creation or transition payload fails schema constraints.
exceptions.rationale: Pre-emptive validation rejection.

exceptions.name: WorkAlreadyExistsError
exceptions.trigger: Attempt to create a work item with an already registered work_id.
exceptions.rationale: Enforces work_id uniqueness within home stream.
